solution:
For a \(2 \times 2\) determinant the value is (product of the leading diagonal) \(-\) (product of the other diagonal).
\(\begin{vmatrix}2 & -4\\7 & -15\end{vmatrix} = (2)(-15) - (-4)(7) = -30 + 28\)
The value of the determinant is \(-2\).

\(\begin{vmatrix}2i & 3\\4 & -i\end{vmatrix} = (2i)(-i) - (3)(4) = -2i^2 - 12\)
Since \(i^2 = -1\), \(-2i^2 = 2\), so the value is \(2 - 12\).
The value of the determinant is \(-10\).

Expand along the first row:
\(\begin{vmatrix}3 & -4 & 5\\1 & 1 & -2\\2 & 3 & 1\end{vmatrix} = 3\begin{vmatrix}1 & -2\\3 & 1\end{vmatrix} - (-4)\begin{vmatrix}1 & -2\\2 & 1\end{vmatrix} + 5\begin{vmatrix}1 & 1\\2 & 3\end{vmatrix}\)
\(= 3(1 + 6) + 4(1 + 4) + 5(3 - 2) = 21 + 20 + 5\)
The value of the determinant is \(46\).

Expand along the first row:
\(\begin{vmatrix}a & h & g\\h & b & f\\g & f & c\end{vmatrix} = a(bc - f^2) - h(hc - fg) + g(hf - bg)\)
\(= abc - af^2 - ch^2 + fgh + fgh - bg^2\)
The value of the determinant is \(abc + 2fgh - af^2 - bg^2 - ch^2\).

Expanding the determinant and equating to zero:
\((x^2 - x + 1)(x + 1) - (x + 1)(x + 1) = 0\)
Take \((x + 1)\) common:
\((x + 1)\big[(x^2 - x + 1) - (x + 1)\big] = 0\), i.e. \((x + 1)(x^2 - 2x) = 0\)
\(\therefore\ x(x + 1)(x - 2) = 0\)
Hence \(x = 0\), \(x = -1\) or \(x = 2\).

Expand along the first row:
\(x\begin{vmatrix}1 & -3\\-4 & 5\end{vmatrix} - (-1)\begin{vmatrix}2x & -3\\3 & 5\end{vmatrix} + 2\begin{vmatrix}2x & 1\\3 & -4\end{vmatrix}\)
\(= x(5 - 12) + 1(10x + 9) + 2(-8x - 3) = -7x + 10x + 9 - 16x - 6 = -13x + 3\)
Given \(-13x + 3 = 29\), so \(-13x = 26\).
Hence \(x = -2\).

Since \(i^2 = -1\), we get \(i^3 = -i\) and \(3i^2 = -3\), so the determinant is \(\begin{vmatrix}4i & -i & 2i\\1 & -3 & 4\\5 & -3 & i\end{vmatrix}\).
Expand along the first row:
\(4i\big[(-3)(i) - (4)(-3)\big] - (-i)\big[(1)(i) - (4)(5)\big] + 2i\big[(1)(-3) - (-3)(5)\big]\)
\(= 4i(-3i + 12) + i(i - 20) + 2i(12) = -12i^2 + 48i + i^2 - 20i + 24i = -11i^2 + 52i\)
With \(i^2 = -1\) this is \(11 + 52i\). Comparing with \(x + iy\):
\(x = 11\) and \(y = 52\).

The third-column entries are \(a_{13} = 2\), \(a_{23} = -4\), \(a_{33} = 0\), with cofactors
\(C_{13} = +\begin{vmatrix}-2 & 3\\-3 & 4\end{vmatrix} = -8 + 9 = 1\), \(C_{23} = -\begin{vmatrix}-1 & 1\\-3 & 4\end{vmatrix} = -(-4 + 3) = 1\), \(C_{33} = +\begin{vmatrix}-1 & 1\\-2 & 3\end{vmatrix} = -3 + 2 = -1\).
Expanding along the third column:
\(a_{13}C_{13} + a_{23}C_{23} + a_{33}C_{33} = 2(1) + (-4)(1) + 0(-1) = 2 - 4\)
The value of the determinant is \(-2\).
